children: IT major Infosys Ltd on Wednesday (November 18) said its wholly owned subsidiary, Infosys Singapore Pte. Ltd., will invest 1.59 billion yen to acquire a 10.1% stake in NTT Docomo Playspace Inc., a joint venture anchored by Japanese telecommunications company NTT Docomo.

Under the agreement, Infosys will join the joint venture as a strategic technology and artificial intelligence (AI) partner, with a focus on developing a new virtual economic ecosystem in the metaverse, integrating real businesses and real-world commerce.
Japan is a strategic market for Infosys, and the partnership will strengthen its presence in the country, the company said in a regulatory filing.

Infosys will bring its global AI-powered deep engineering capabilities, Infosys Topaz and Metaverse Foundry capabilities, to the joint venture. The collaboration will focus on developing immersive experiences, digital twins and virtual commerce in Japan for global markets.

Infosys will participate as a minority investor and will have rights as a minority shareholder, including the right to nominate one director to the joint venture's board. The company said the investment adds to its existing joint venture, HIPUS, in Japan.

Infosys Singapore will enter into the joint venture agreement with NTT Docomo, a company incorporated under Japanese law. Infosys said neither party is related to its promoter or promoter group, and the transaction does not fall under related-party transactions.
Shares of Infosys Ltd ended at ₹1,109.00, down by ₹21.00, or 1.86%, on the BSE.

title: Infosys partners with NTT Docomo for AI-powered Metaverse ecosystem in Japan
